analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (30,040 KRW) vs SMA5 (30,847 KRW) / SMA20 (31,298 KRW) / SMA50 (34,445 KRW): Below short-term and mid-term trends, below long-term trends.
· Position relative to SMA100 (37,595 KRW) / SMA200 (36,379 KRW): Below long-term trends, indicating long-term weakness.
· 52-week position (33.3%) + Recovery phase from historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (49.0→43.1): Neutral sustained, consolidating after exiting oversold.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-179.3047→161.0457): Improving, signaling exit from bearish consolidation.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Mid-band 31,298 KRW): Trading around the mid-band, 38.86% band width suggests potential for increased volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (29,960 KRW): Support based on Pivot S1 (24,595 KRW) and 20-day low (27,045 KRW).
· Swing resistance (30,570 KRW): Breakout expected to initiate short-term upside.
· 5-day / 20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): Recovery signal, potential trend reversal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.48x): Increased momentum, higher confidence in price action.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation): Consider buying on breakout above 30,570 KRW, otherwise maintain a wait-and-see approach.
